verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਤਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਜੁਗਾ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਹਲੀ ਘਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satijug sat tretai jugaa dhuaapar poojaa bahalee ghaalaa|

en.bdb: In satyug the truth, in treta and dvapar worship and ascetice discipline were in vogue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug gurmukh naau lai paar pavai bhavajal bharanaalaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs, in kaliyug go across the world-ocean by repeating the name of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਤਿਜੁਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਰਣ ਉਕਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar charan satijugai vich tretai chauthai charan ukaalaa|

en.bdb: Dharma had four feet in the satyug but in treta, the fourth foot of dharma was made cripple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਕਤੈ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੰਮੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuaapur hoe pair dhui ikatai pair dhara(n)m dhukhaalaa|

en.bdb: In dvapar only two feet of dharma survived and in kaliyug the dharma stands only on one foot to undergo the sufferings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: maan nimaanai jaan kai binau karai kar nadhar nihaalaa|

en.bdb: Considering the Lord as the strength of the powerless ones, it (dharma) started praying for the liberation through the grace of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur poorai paragaas kar dheeraj dharam sachee dharamasaalaa|

en.bdb: The Lord manifesting in the form of the perfect Gum created the true abode of fortitude and the dharma.
Himself is the field (of creation) and Himself its protector.
